Project Announcement & Technical Preview (v0.2.0) • x64 & ARM64

RaggieSoft Installer Studio — Install Without Limits.

An in-development, zero-dependency native Win32 C++20 Windows packaging suite for x64 and ARM64. Design projects visually with modern AeroWizards, Destination Computer folder trees, and a Dual C++ & MSI.DLL Dialog Designer—or let coding agents author plain-text, comment-preserving .rsip manifests that compile straight into real .msi, .msm, .mst, .msp, and WCAG 2.2 AA Setup.exe installers.

[Package]
Name              = Sample Studio IDE
Version           = 1.0.0
Manufacturer      = Sample Studio
UpgradeCode       = {8F4E20A1-7C93-4D62-9B44-1029384756AB}
Architecture      = $(ARCH)
Scope             = machine

[Install]
DefaultSubdir     = Sample StudioIDE
MainExecutable    = SampleIde.exe

[UI]
WizardLayout      = aerowizard
MsiDialogPreset   = express_custom

[Component.CoreBin]
Feature           = Main
TargetRoot        = INSTALLDIR
KeyPathKind       = file
KeyPathTarget     = SampleIde.exe

[Payload.App]

Component         = CoreBin

[FileAssociation.ProjectFile]
Extension         = .sproj
ProgId            = SampleStudio.IDE.Project
Description       = Sample Studio Project
TargetFile        = SampleIde.exe
Verbs             = open:&Open:"%1"
Why I'm Building This • Open Engineering Roadmap

What RaggieSoft Installer Studio Aims to Solve

Every major Windows installer suite ultimately marshals calls down into the exact same msi.dll and cabinet.dll libraries Microsoft already ships inside C:\Windows\System32 on every copy of Windows. Yet developers are routinely forced to choose between multi-thousand-dollar legacy tools, steep XML learning curves, unlabeled non-accessible wizard forms, or opaque binary project files that fight Git version control and AI coding agents.

RaggieSoft Installer Studio is an active, open-source MIT engineering effort to build a modern, zero-dependency native Win32 C++20 packaging suite from the ground up—combining visual convenience with clean plain-text .rsip manifests and 100% WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility.

Shipping Today in Technical Preview (v0.2.0)

  • 9-View Win32 C++20 IDE (InstallerStudio.exe) with 4 native AeroWizards (Project Assistant, Component & KeyPath, File Associations, and Release / .MST / .MSP)
  • Destination Computer Tree & Setup Design enforcing Microsoft's Official Component Rules (Single-Directory Rule, File KeyPaths, ICE38 HKCU Registry KeyPaths, & ICE18 CreateFolder)
  • Dual Dialog Designer authoring both C++20 Glass / AeroWizard SetupWizard.exe screens AND native 370×270 MSI.DLL Dialog SQL tables (Express / Compact / Custom workflow)
  • First-Class File Associations supporting both zero-popup HKMU\Software\Classes registration and native MSI ProgId / Extension / Verb / MIME tables
  • msiprism.exe 64-bit Dark Mode SQL table inspector + instbuild.exe --emit-ai-spec & --emit-vpat

Next Milestones on the Workbench

  • Full Dogfood Rollout: Validating real-world upgrades, repairs, and uninstalls across all 77 RaggieSoft Windows apps, interactive novels, and audio archives
  • System Services & Environment Tables: Visual & declarative authoring for Windows Services (ServiceInstall / ServiceControl) and PATH environment variables
  • Custom Actions & Prerequisite Checks: Guided AeroWizards for safe deferred system actions and runtime detection
  • Community Feedback First: Free, open-source MIT previews with zero registration walls while the architecture matures in public
Core Engineering Design Principles

The "Zero-Bloat" Architecture Matrix

Technical Architecture Goals for RaggieSoft Installer Studio
Design Pillar RaggieSoft Installer Studio Why It Matters
Toolchain Footprint Under 3 MB per architecture (InstallerStudio.exe, instbuild.exe, SetupWizard.exe & msiprism.exe) Instant startup on local developer workstations and CI runners without multi-gigabyte framework installs.
Runtime Dependencies Zero third-party DLLs (System32\msi.dll, cabinet.dll, & gdiplus.dll only) Runs cold on stock Windows 11 (x64 & native ARM64) with no .NET or VC++ redistributable prerequisites.
Microsoft MSI Rules ICE18, ICE38, ICE64 & ICE80 Enforced Validates Single-Directory Component rules, HKCU user-profile KeyPaths, CreateFolder, and 64-bit component attributes before msi.dll runs.
White-Label Output 100% Author-Owned VERSIONINFO Compiled Setup.exe and .msi packages display your publisher name, icon, and copyright—zero third-party watermarks.
Offline & Privacy First Zero Telemetry / Zero Crypto Gimmicks No mandatory cloud accounts, no background network calls, and no cryptocurrency/blockchain bundles.
Four Native Binaries in One Cohesive Toolkit

Suite Spotlight: AeroWizard IDE, CLI Compiler & MSI Prism

InstallerStudio.exe — 9-View C++20 Visual IDE

Features 4 guided Win32 AeroWizards, an InstallShield-style Destination Computer folder tree, Setup Design (Features → Components → KeyPaths), File Associations, Dual C++ & MSI.DLL Dialog Designers, and a 100% comment-preserving .rsip AST!

Explore .rsip v0.3 Schema

instbuild.exe — Headless CI & AI Spec Compiler

Sub-millisecond --validate --diagnostics=json linting, automated --emit-vpat WCAG 2.2 AA conformance reports, and built-in --emit-ai-spec generation (llms.txt, llms-full.txt, SKILL.md) emitted directly from the C++20 constexpr grammar.

View Live /llms.txt Spec

msiprism.exe — Native 64-Bit MSI & MST Inspector

A clean, modern 64-bit (x64 & ARM64) Dark Mode replacement for Microsoft's 1999 32-bit Orca.exe—inspecting relational SQL tables across .msi, .msm, and .msp databases.
